title: No percolation at criticality on quasi-transitive graphs
summary: We prove that critical Bernoulli bond percolation has no infinite cluster on any infinite connected locally finite quasi-transitive graph with critical probability less than one. This resolves the bond form of the criticality conjecture of Benjamini and Schramm.
family_title: Critical percolation on every quasi-transitive graph

review.reason: Proves no infinite cluster at criticality for bond percolation on quasi-transitive graphs.
